title: British Cod Fish and Chips
description: A classic British recipe of cod fish and chips, pan-fried to perfection. This dish is a staple of British cuisine and is easy to make at home.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Cut the chips into long, thin strips and soak them in cold water for 30 minutes.
Drain the chips and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the cod fillets with salt, pepper, and curry powder (if using).
Dredge the cod fillets in flour, shaking off excess.
Fry the cod fillets in the hot oil for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the cod from the oil and place it on a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Fry the chips in the hot oil for 3-4 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the chips from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Serve the cod with the chips and a sprinkle of smoked paprika (if using).
